UMass Biostatistics is part of the **Department of Biostatistics and Epidemiology** in the School of Public Health & Health Sciences, which has about 20 faculty. Our program has **10 tenure-track faculty and lecturers, 24 MS students and 17 PhD students**, so students and faculty get to know each other well.
